# Language Features: Strings

Searching, slicing, converting and formatting text.

Working with text: searching, slicing, changing case, formatting numbers as text and converting characters. Drawing text on screen is in [Fonts and Text](BlitzBasic-Fonts-and-Text). Dates and times as text are in [Time & Date](Language-Features-Time-and-Date).

Back to [Language Features](Language-Features) or the [Command Index](Command-Index).
